repo_notes.content: ReCALL is a Ruby on Rails 2.3.14 flashcard learning system for medical students. It is a legacy pre-Bundler Rails app: setup requires renaming config/database.example.yml, config/environment.example.rb, and vendor/plugin/sitealizer/lib/config.example.yml; listed gems include fastercsv, tiny_mce, will_paginate 2.3.16, rspec, and gherkin. Authentication is provided by the vendored acts_as_authenticated plugin.

Core model: Cards (flashcards) are grouped into Piles (decks) and organized via Categories and CategoriesTypes. The learning loop lives in piles_controller#learn with dedicated views (learn.html.erb, learn.mobile.erb). Piles can be exported as RSS/Atom feeds, PDF (lib/pdf_pile.rb via prawn, show.pdf.prawn), and print views, and there are parallel mobile (.mobile.erb) views throughout.

Supporting features: user accounts with activation/forgot-password mailers (user_notifier, error_mailer), an admin area (admin_controller), info pages with an RSS builder, full-text search (search_controller), a sitemap (sitemap_controller + sitemap.rxml), Danish and English locales (config/locales/da.yml, en.yml), and tiny_mce rich-text config. Tests use test/unit, test/functional, and YAML fixtures.
